description: Invite a person to join your organization by email at a chosen role. The organization is fixed by your context - never pass an organization id. Valid roles: Admin, Finance, Manager, Member, Viewer (you can only invite at a role no more privileged than your own). Once the user confirms, the invitation is created and the invitee is emailed an acceptance link. The result's mail_sent says whether that email went out: say the invitation was emailed ONLY when mail_sent is true. When mail_sent is false the invitation exists but its email could not be sent - say so, and that an admin can resend it or copy its link from the Users page.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite (required).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

role.description: Role to grant on acceptance (required). One of: Admin, Finance, Manager, Member, Viewer. You cannot invite at a role more privileged than your own.

name: invite_user
